name: Work Anniversary Email Workflow
description: Receives employee data from the orchestrator for employees whose work anniversary (DD.MM of dateOfJoining) matches today. Uses a SAP Agent to generate a personalized anniversary email body, then logs the email. Replace the log node with an email node when a provider is configured.

parameters.chatInput: ={{ 'Write a warm and sincere work anniversary email congratulating ' + $json.employeeName + ' on completing ' + $json.yearsOfService + ' year(s) with the company. Address them by first name. Keep it to 3-4 sentences. Return only the email body text, no subject line.' }}

parameters.content: This configuration is hardcoded — the values in this node reflect what you provided. Replace the Log node with a Microsoft Outlook or other email node when an email provider is configured.

Generate Anniversary Email.response: Dear Shekhar, congratulations on completing 5 wonderful years with our company! Your dedication and contributions have been truly invaluable to the team. We are so grateful to have you with us, and we look forward to many more successful years together. Happy Work Anniversary!
